hero.tagline: We exist to build, ship, and sustain the infrastructure that raises the standard of engineering at 42 Amman and beyond.

statement: Membership here is not a title you hold —
missionValues.detail: Every tier, every vote, every hour of mentorship is logged, evaluated, and never assumed.

values.text: Every contribution is recorded, not remembered. XP, evaluations, and votes trace back to an auditable entry — nothing here runs on hearsay or seniority.
Tiers are earned through evaluations, events, and peer recognition — never through how long you've been a member.
The goal isn't finishing your own project quietly. It's leaving the node stronger than you found it — through mentorship, cross-node votes, and the evaluations you sit for others.
Production-oriented means what it says: judged by real, sustained infrastructure, not by a claim a neighboring club could make unchanged.
